title: params of tickets.write
description: Create or update finding tickets THROUGH THE KIT'S RECONCILER, for findings the kit itself established in a default-branch security run. The same cluster stamp, lookup-before-create, routing and ledger as the pipeline's reconciliation, so an API-created ticket and a pipeline-created ticket for one finding are one ticket. No inline findings, no closure, no disposition.

run_id.description: A completed run of the repository's security caller on the default branch, by id, or "latest" for the newest such run that kept its evidence.

select.description: Which of that run's findings to ticket. At least one list non-empty; at most 100 entries in all.

requested_disposition.description: Accepted by the schema only so that the refusal is named: a disposition request is never made through the API (API_DISPOSITION_NOT_VIA_API).
